reference_boundary: OpenAI/Codex source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest promotes platform-neutral ADK subagent governance contracts and must not enable Agents SDK, Codex subagents runtime, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults.

must_not: spawn nested subagents without explicit max_depth approval
treat subagent completion as integrated completion
allow subagents to write shared contracts unless they own the integration task
return raw logs, full stack traces, command transcripts or exploratory notes to the parent unless they are explicitly retained as evidence artifacts

quality_gates: parent verifies integration after worker completion
nested subagents require explicit max_depth approval
worker returns distilled summary and evidence references instead of raw intermediate output
raw logs or transcripts are linked as artifacts only when retention decision is explicit

summary_token_budget.exceed_policy: link artifacts instead of pasting raw output

context_noise_budget.raw_output_policy: Raw logs, stack traces, command transcripts and exploratory notes are not merged into the parent context unless retained as explicit evidence artifacts with redaction status.
quality_gates: subagent replies start with distilled summary and evidence references
raw output requires an explicit retention decision
parent agent integrates worker results only after checking conflict and verification evidence
large logs are summarized with artifact references instead of copied into the parent thread
must_not: paste raw command transcripts into the parent context by default
treat worker completion as parent completion
hide failed verification inside a long raw-output appendix

quality_gates: description must be narrow enough for routing
write-capable agents must declare sandbox and scope_write
docs or research agents default to read-only
custom agent name is the source of truth
delegated agents must keep noisy exploration out of the parent thread and return summary plus evidence references

contracts.handoff_condition: Return when assigned scope is implemented, blocked, or verification fails twice.
contracts.conflict_policy: Do not revert other workers or user changes; report overlap and stop before editing conflicting files.
